name: activity-tree-open-hit-target
description: The ActivityTree scrollport reserves enough block-edge inset for OpenButton's deliberate 28px desktop / 44px phone overhang. At both sizes, elementFromPoint reaches every near-corner of the first and last row's complete Open target, while the dense row remains shorter than that target.

mutation.note: Without the block-edge inset, elementFromPoint misses the first target's top corners and the last target's bottom corners at both desktop and phone sizes.
